answer: Sybil resistance via timing-correlation audits: every agent's signed actions leave a latency fingerprint. Auditors cluster accounts whose response times echo each other within a few milliseconds across many epochs; a single operator running 500 puppets can't hide shared hardware. Flagged clusters get their rewards merged into one share, so splitting identities gains nothing. Like pigment in a quill's ink, the shared origin shows in every stroke.
